method.build: Next 16.3.8 optimized production mode, existing repository loopback browser fixture configuration; same pinned Node 24.18.0/dependencies; no hosted Clerk/Sentry traffic
method.cache: Fresh nonpersistent context each run, browser cache cleared and disabled; no auth profile reused
method.order: Three baseline runs then three candidate runs; same host/port/protocol/config/browser and exclusive shared workload lock
method.lcp: Last observed first-viewport LCP after load, image decode and fonts ready, before any scroll/input; LCP element is the mobile product PNG
method.scroll: From top to full document bottom, 633 CSS px per 150 ms; no tabs changed. Decode all encountered images and await document.fonts.ready; verify request completion. Same eager-image composition; no URL backgrounds/external fonts.
method.full_scroll_asset_completion: Navigation-relative max responseEnd for img/css/link/script resource entries discovered through full scroll, plus document responseEnd. Covers all encountered images, CSS, scripts and fonts; excludes favicon, route-data prefetches and verification/idle after assets completed. Kept separately from loadEventEnd and scan-completion time.
method.transfer: CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength summed for actual browser traffic through scan, including headers and route prefetches; Resource Timing encodedBodySize and source PNG bytes separately. First baseline run also has extra CDP bytes; all runs retained.
method.host_contention: Shared lock waited 7m31s before baseline build, then held for both builds and both three-run/capture phases. Other-owner heavy work excluded cooperatively. Background nonbenchmark processes remained: baseline-start load average 5.20 and brief gog/Claude spikes; candidate-start 4.15 with lower competing CPU. Raw host snapshots retained; timing estimates may include host noise, although run ranges were narrow.
method.live_limit: Local estimates do not predict absolute hosted release timings: hosted Clerk/UI/analytics requests, edge TTFB/protocol and host hardware differ. No synthetic score or live guarantee.

visual.stabilization: Same fresh fixtures, release metadata fixed to base SHA in both builds, same system fonts/ready state. Wait finite interaction transitions to finish; align observed infinite animations only (none observed on homepage). No masks, CSS/content changes, hidden elements or tolerance.

functional.limits: No authenticated hosted session or real Clerk signup exercised; existing fixture signup boundary used. Auth, analytics, logging, errors and runtime source have zero changes. Hosted browser CI covers broader existing interaction suites.
